messages:
alex: Heads-up — I spotted a risky pattern in a few READMEs: snippets that write the API key to /tmp and then cat it into curl. That encourages creds-on-disk and accidental leaks.
marta: which files?
alex: docs/dev/quickstart.md under 'Try it locally' and samples/echo-bot/README. example shows:
```
echo $REDWOOD_API_KEY > /tmp/redwood_token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $(cat /tmp/redwood_token)\" -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'
```
samir: oof. We should never encourage writing secrets to disk in examples. Replace with using env var directly or point to the CLI/login flow. Also recommend .env (gitignored) for local dev.
docs-qa: I'll draft a PR. Proposal:
```
# set in your shell (do NOT paste real keys in public places)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-REDACTED"

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'
```
I'll add a short security callout: "Avoid pasting real API keys into screenshots, repos, or shared terminals. Use the Redwood CLI or a gitignored .env file."
marta: also patch samples/echo-bot/README and the onboarding cheatsheet — they mirror that bad snippet.
devbot: lint-snippets: found 2 occurrences of 'echo $REDWOOD_API_KEY >' in repo (docs/dev/quickstart.md, samples/echo-bot/README)
alex: nice. docs-qa, can you also add a note about avoiding `cat` in examples and include token rotation/expiration best practices? link to security checklist?
docs-qa: yep. I'll add a small docs-smoke test that fails if snippets write to /tmp or contain literal 'sk-' patterns. also include suggested bash-safe wrapper that reads from env and aborts on 'REDACTED'.
samir: assign me to review the PR. i'd like the wrapper to error loudly if the var looks like a placeholder so newcomers don't run with example tokens.
alex: plan: docs-qa opens PR, updates quickstart + sample app + cheatsheet, adds lint rule. marta to update sample app and CI workflow. samir to review. i'll post a short note in #general after merge so new signups see guidance.
marta: will also scan other snippets (docker examples, .github workflows). found one in .github/workflows/test.yml echoing keys into env — fixing that too.
alex: thanks all :thumbsup
